AddImage.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the AddImage API, which is used to add image information to an Image Search instance.

schema.description:
Image Search instance name. It can contain up to 20 characters.  
If you have already purchased an Image Search instance, you can log on to the [Image Search console](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view it.  
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, see [Activate the service](~~179178~~) and [Create an instance](~~66569~~).  
> Note that the instance name here is not the instance ID. Make sure to distinguish between them when using this parameter.

Image category. For more information, see [Category reference](~~179184~~).  
> - For Product Search, if a category is specified, the specified value is used; otherwise, the system performs category prediction, and the predicted category can be obtained from the response.  
<props="china">  
- For Fabric, Trademark, Generic, Furniture & Home, and Industrial Hardware searches, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether a category is specified.  
</props>  
- For Generic Search, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether a category is specified.

Product ID, supporting up to 512 characters.  

> A product can have multiple images.

Image name, supporting up to 512 characters.  
> - Product ID and PicName uniquely identify an image.  
- If multiple images are added with the same Product ID and PicName, only the last added image is retained, and previously added images will be overwritten.

Image content, Base64-encoded.  

 - Image size must not exceed 4 MB.  
 - Supported image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP, TIFF, PPM.  
 - Transmission timeout must not exceed 5 seconds.  
<props="china">  
 - For product image search and generic image search, both image height and width must be between 100 and 4096 pixels (inclusive).  
 - For trademark image search, both image height and width must be between 200 and 4096 pixels (inclusive).  
 - For fabric image search, both image height and width must be between 448 and 4096 pixels (inclusive).  
</props>  
<props="intl">  
 - For product image search and generic image search, both image height and width must be between 100 and 4096 pixels (inclusive).  
</props>  
 - The image must not contain rotation information.

Specifies whether subject identification is required. The default value is true.  
- If set to true, the system performs subject identification and uses the identified subject for search. The subject identification result can be obtained in the Response.  
- If set to false, subject identification is not performed, and the entire image is used for search.  

<props="china">For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored, and the system uses the entire image for search.</props>

Subject area of the image, formatted as `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` represents the top-left point and `x2,y2` represents the bottom-right point.  
<props="china">  
> - If the user specifies a Region, the system uses the specified Region for search regardless of the Crop parameter value.  
- For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored, and the system uses the entire image for search.  
</props>  
<props="intl">  
> For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored, and the system uses the entire image for search.  
</props>

User-defined content, supporting up to 4096 characters.  
> This field is returned during queries. For example, you can add a textual description of the image.
Integer-type property, which can be used for filtering during queries. This field is returned in query results.
String-type property, supporting up to 128 characters. It can be used for filtering during queries, and this field is returned in query results.

PicInfo.description: Information such as category prediction and subject identification results.

Region.description: Subject identification result. The subject area of the image, in the format `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` represents the top-left point and `x2,y2` represents the bottom-right point. If a subject area is specified in the user's request, the specified value takes precedence.

CategoryId.description: Category prediction result. If a category is specified in the user's request, the specified value takes precedence.

AddImage.title: Add Image Data
AddImage.description:
### How-To  
This API is used to add image information to an Image Search instance.  

### Queries per second (QPS) limit  
For instances with a capacity of 100,000 images, the default concurrent request limit is 1, meaning that at most one image addition request can be processed per second.  

For instances with other image capacities, the default concurrent request limit is 5, meaning that at most five image addition requests can be processed per second.

DeleteImage.title: Delete Image
DeleteImage.summary: This topic describes the syntax and sample of the DeleteImage API, which is used to delete image information from an Image Search instance.
DeleteImage.description:
### How-To  
This API is used to delete image information from an Image Search instance.  

> If the specified image does not exist in the Image Search instance, this API still returns Succeeded. You cannot use the Return Result to determine whether the image exists.  

### queries per second (QPS) limit  
By default, the concurrent limit for delete operations is 20, meaning that up to 20 delete requests can be processed per second.

Search type. Valid values:  
- SearchByPic (default): Searches for similar images based on an uploaded image.  
- SearchByName: Searches for similar images based on an image that has already been added.

Filter condition. The supported operators for int_attr are the greater than sign (>), greater than or equal to sign (>=), less than sign (<), less than or equal to sign (<=), and equal sign (=). The supported operators for str_attr are the equal sign (=) and not equal sign (!=). Multiple conditions can be connected using AND or OR.  
Examples:  
- int_attr >= 100.  
- str_attr != "value1".  
- int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1".
schema.example: (int_attr >= 100000000 AND int_attr < 200000000 AND int_attr=100000252 AND str_attr=\"87\")

SortExprValues.description:
System scoring information.  
> - This field is deprecated. We recommend using Score instead.  
- SortExprValues is a semicolon-separated pair of values. The first value represents the image relevance score; a higher value indicates greater relevance to the query image. Due to differences in algorithm models:  
- When the category is 0–2, the range of SortExprValues is 0–7.33136443711219e+24.  
- For other category values, the range of SortExprValues is 0–5.37633353624177e+24. This score reaches its maximum when two images are identical.

CategoryId.description:
Category prediction result.  
If the user specifies a category in the request, the specified category takes precedence.

SearchImage.title: Search Image
SearchImage.summary: This topic describes the syntax and sample of the searchbyimage API for online invocation in Taobao Consortium Edition.
SearchImage.description:
### Queries per second (QPS) limits  
The default maximum query frequency can be viewed in the console, which corresponds to the visit frequency (queries per second (QPS)) you selected when purchasing. Currently, 1 QPS, 5 QPS, and 10 QPS are supported.  

### SDK Version Guide  
Upgrade the image software development kit (SDK) to V3.1.1 to use the "multi-entity identification" and "similarity score" features. For more information, see [Java SDK](~~179188~~).
